title: collomia debilis
intro: Collomia debilis, commonly known as fringed prairie gentian, is a perennial wildflower plant that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Collomia debilis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids and gentiopicrin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
